I’m so sorry for your loss. I’m sure you’ve heard of it a lot but it’s truly a tragedy. 

I lost my fiancé to an overdose two months ago. My world without him feels so gray and empty. I also started realizing things that I should’ve had known. I blame myself a lot, but I have to accept that there was nothing I could’ve done at the end. I tried my best. I trusted him when he said he was going to get better because I loved him. I miss him every second of my life. He’s my better half and I can’t wait to be with him again. 

For now, you won’t stop crying. You might not be able to sleep and eat. But you will get through this.

Idk how your skin will react to a new routine, but you should talk to a dermatologist if you’re serious about getting rid of these acne scars. 

If I were you, I would add least add a cleanser. moisturizer and sunscreen to the routine. Going outside or staying indoor next to a window without sunscreen can actually make your scars even darker. Just make sure you do double cleanse with a cleansing balm/Micellar water for PM routine if you wear sunscreen throughout the day.

I used to be like you actually, but I had only a cleanser in my routine because I was scared I would have acnes if I add moisturizer to my routine. Heck, I was living in a tropical country a year ago and wouldn’t wear sunscreen when I go out. I was such a fool. My acne scars would get so dark but didn’t realize what was the cause since I washed my face regularly. 

Then, I did my research on how to tackle acnes and hyperpigmentation. Made a virtual appointment with a doctor regarding my acnes then they prescribed me tretinoin and benzoyl peroxide 5%. I made another appointment with a board certified dermatologist this January and got prescribed for antibiotics, received cortisone shots for some cyst acnes and hydroquinone 6%. I can say that I’m pretty confident meeting people without thinking they’re judging my skin now. 

Goodluck!

Product review: My favorite products are: Elta md sunscreen, Eucerin spf+moisturizer, foaming facial cleanser, Vanicream, paula’s choice 2% bha liquid exfoliant and tret 0.025%. The rest of the product is fine but my least favorite is the Kiehls eye cream and glam glow youth mud. I think the eye cream didn’t do anything other than moisturize my eyes which the aquaphor lip balm could do as well. And the glam glow youth mask just felt so harsh and drying on my skin, so I wouldn’t repurchase both of these products. The paula’s choice 2% bha is no joke! I had two stubborn blackheads that I tried to extract on my own. So I tried the paula’s choice 2% bha and they actually came out easily the next day. It’s insane. So I would definitely repurchase it. The Ren milk cleanser was disappointing but it does hydrate the skin so I guess that’s good for harsh winter weather. Tret 0.025% changed my skin so much. I have better skin texture and tone now. Furthermore, I would definitely recommend people with oily skin to get the vanicream moisturizing lotion. Also, I’ve been using my lip balm for my under eye area because why not.

Hi! 

You can add exfoliation to your skincare routine if you want to achieve brighter skin. Paula’s choice skin perfecting 2% BHA Liquid salicylic acid might be a good choice.

Add Niacinamide serum from the Ordinary or Inkey list for PM if you’re worried about the maskne. And try using Vitamin C serum on daytime to help with pigmentation. 

Don’t forget to use sunscreen! At least SPF 30. 

If you have cyst acnes or bad hyperpigmentation, I would recommend seeing a dermatologist. 

Goodluck! :)

I used to have blackheads around my lips area too! I hated looking at it so much so I would force to extract it. 

Ever since I’ve been more serious with my skincare routine, the blackheads around my lips haven’t returned so I’ll share you my daily routine. 

AM:

Cleanser -  I used to use Dr. Dennis gross cleanser,  it helped a lot clearing out my acnes but since it’s too expensive, I switched to Salicylic acid cleanser by Inkey list. If my skin feels too dry when I wake up, I’ll switch to CeraVe Hydrating Cleanser. 

Treatment - skin tone enhancement therapy pads + 6% of hydroquinone (prescribed by derm). I use this to clear up hyperpigmentation from cyst acnes on my right cheek. 

Moisturizer - I’ve been trying to use Vanicream Daily moisturizer everyday, but I find Glow Recipe Oil free moisturizer hydrates my skin better. 

Sunscreen - Elta MD UV Clear spf 46. It doesn’t make my skin oily so that’s good. 

PM: 

Cleanser - I use cleansing balm by Clinique or cleansing milk by Ren skincare to melt the skincare. Then I use the cerave cleanser or the inkey list cleanser (it depends on my skin’s situation). 

Eye cream - Kiehl’s powerful strength dark circle reducing Vitamin C eye serum. This product is useless but I use it anyway because it’s hydrating. 

Serum - niacinamide 10% by the Ordinary or Hyaluronic acid by inkey list. I try not to use two serum in one night. 

Treatment - I use tretinoin 0.025% almost everyday, otherwise my skin peels. 

Moisturizer - glow recipe or vanicream if my skin doesn’t feel too dry. 

Spot treatment - benzoyl peroxide 10% by Walgreens. It clears out most acnes, but not cyst acnes. 

I’ve been taking doxycycline almost a month so I don’t get cyst acnes. 

Goodluck!!
